notion.note: Owner pastes the script / outline / brief directly; no Notion read or tick.

voice.provider: ElevenLabs REST via the agent's connector: studio el plan voice EP (no key in files)
voice.tag: [casual, upbeat, fast-paced, playful, like telling a friend a funny animal fact]

tools.gemini_api: optional upgrade if the owner adds a Gemini key: studio img plan/save through a connector
tools.flow: Google Flow web UI (Nano Banana 2.1) in a browser the owner signed in to (skill flow-art)
tools.muse: Muse media.generate_image (default): art_plan.json → studio img todo → generate each, chaining with resume_from_snapshot_id / the reference attached; photoreal props and plates, real person every episode (channel/prompts.md Non-negotiable)

images.never: never draw physical objects in PIL or as clip-art/vector icons; never draw with ElevenLabs

music.provider: ElevenLabs REST via connector: studio el plan music EP
music.prompt: Light quirky curious underscore, minor key, 110-140 bpm, pizzicato and soft plucks with light percussion, no vocals, loops cleanly, playful-mysterious documentary-for-kids feel

sfx.provider: ElevenLabs Sound Effects via connector: write audio/sfx_plan.json, then studio el plan sfx EP
sfx.per_episode: 15-25 distinct sounds, one per kind of action

known_false_fails.hook_end_s: reads the first Whisper segment, not the first sentence
known_false_fails.jitter: handheld jitter: keyframed block slides / loops / diagram swaps read as camera pan; ok when within ~1 % of the gate after kicks and handheld are minimised
